items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I finally let Johnny Hodges and Edie Q., his wife, have that apartment at 555 Edgecombe.

ctx.x: Yes, I had an apartment in New York. In fact, the same apartment I had, I finally let Johnny Hodges and Edie Q., his wife, have that apartment at 555 Edgecombe. That was my apartment, 9H. I never forget that. I let them have it later on, my apartment, when I was moving, right up over the Polo Grounds.
